pairs.difference: Both are plain spheres with a flat round cap and panel seams. A has crisp narrow seams, B has softer, blurrier seams. Nothing in the form clearly separates them.
A's target is a thick, puffy slab with a fat rim, and its frame top is a curved arch. B's target is a thinner disc and its frame is built from straight, flat boards.
pairs.fix: Draw the target as a thin flat disc with a tight edge. Make the frame from straight flat boards with a straight top beam.

pairs.difference: B's body is swollen. It has big soft rounded corners and a puffy front panel, and the vent slot is oddly notched. A is a flatter box with straight runs and a thin trim line.
pairs.fix: Draw the air conditioner as a flat-faced box with straight edges and tight corner bevels. Make the vent a thin straight slot.

pairs.difference: A has chunky, fat gold bands, a heavy rounded lid and a fat base, so it reads like a toy. B has thin straps, small rivets and flat plank faces.
pairs.fix: Use thin gold straps, flat plank faces and a lid with tight edges. Do not add heavy bulbous gold trim.

pairs.difference: A's crown is puffy and fat, with a thick rolled brim and a chunky badge. B has a thin, flat visor and a flatter badge.
pairs.fix: Make the crown lower and flatter. Give the visor a thin, crisp edge and the badge a flat disc.

pairs.difference: A has a heavy domed roof, thick frame bars and a thick base. B has thin window bars and flat panels with tighter proportions.
pairs.fix: Draw thinner window bars, flat door panels and a slim base plinth with crisp corners.

pairs.difference: B's gloves are swollen blobs with very fat thumbs and little separation between cuff and fist. A shows defined cuffs and a clearer fist-to-cuff relation.
pairs.fix: Draw smaller, tighter gloves with a distinct cuff and a thumb in proportion.

pairs.difference: B's fins are broad, even paddles with fat rounded rims and soft corners. A's blades taper and have thin edges and distinct foot pockets.
pairs.fix: Make the blades narrower and tapered with thin edges. Add distinct foot pockets and ribs, and keep the corners tight.

pairs.difference: B has oversized posts, a rope wrapped into fat sausage coils and a huge life ring, and the thin railings are missing. A has thin rails, small posts and planar planks.
pairs.fix: Draw thin rope, thin rails and flat planks. Keep the posts and the life ring in true proportion to the pier.

pairs.difference: A's leaves are broad and puffy and its trunk is thick. B has thinner pointed fronds and a slimmer trunk.
pairs.fix: Draw slimmer, pointed fronds and a thinner trunk.

pairs.difference: A has soft blobby corners, fat embossed vents and a thick door. B has crisp box corners, flat faces and a thin handle.
pairs.fix: Draw the locker as a flat sheet-metal box with tight corners, thin slot vents and a thin door.

pairs.difference: B's slide is a fat swollen tube with thick rails, and it has no platform railing. A has thin ladder rungs, a railing and more parts.
pairs.fix: Draw a thinner slide channel. Add a platform railing and thin ladder rungs.

pairs.difference: B's player is a pillowy rounded blob with soft corners and a swollen face. A has a flatter face, tight bevels and thin cables.
pairs.fix: Make the player a flat-faced slab with small tight corner radii, flat buttons and thin cables.

pairs.difference: B's envelope is puffy, with fat rounded corners and a thick flap. A is a thin flat envelope with straight edges.
pairs.fix: Draw a thin flat envelope with straight edges and tight corners. Make the flap a thin fold.

pairs.difference: Both are plates of chunky fruit. A has a thin, shallow plate and B has a rounder, deeper one. No clear difference in form.
B has an oversized bow and a soft arched door. A has flat panels, a straight frame and a more open wreath ring.
pairs.fix: Make the bow smaller. Draw flat door panels with straight frames and an open, airy wreath.

pattern: Generated cards fatten and soften the form. Corners become rounded blobs, and thin parts (rails, straps, rope, cable) turn into thick sausages or disappear. Flat boxes swell like pillows, and the parts they do have are simplified and bigger than in real cards. Real cards keep planar faces, tight bevels and thin parts.
